NYMPH_EVENT_NYMPH_ENCOUNTER.title: Encounter
NYMPH_EVENT_NYMPH_ENCOUNTER.pages.INITIA: The black beast clamps its jaws around its prey's throat until the struggling stops and the body goes limp. Suddenly, a golden light flashes across the wilderness. An unfamiliar creature stands there, its mane gleaming in the sun and its fangs and claws proclaiming its strength. What could it be? The black beast releases its prey, fixes its gaze upon the newcomer, and then...
It invites the other to share its prey
Gain [gold]Graffiti of the Age of Hope[/gold].
Gain [gold]Hatred of the Age of Nemesis[/gold].
Gain [gold]Remembrance of the Age of Beautiful Wishes[/gold].
NYMPH_EVENT_NYMPH_ENCOUNTER.pages.HOPE.d: Thousands of years later, people of different races no longer distinguish between one another. Cooperation brings mutual benefit; everyone agrees on that.
NYMPH_EVENT_NYMPH_ENCOUNTER.pages.NEMESI: The Sarkaz kill their prey, and the prey's descendants kill the Sarkaz in turn. Either you die or I do. Terra offers no second path.
NYMPH_EVENT_NYMPH_ENCOUNTER.pages.WISH.d: At that moment, the Teekaz heard an earnest wish: the creature before it wished never to hunger again. So the Teekaz gave it the prey, watched it die from gluttony, and made a feast of it. Sadly, those who came after remembered only that the Teekaz could grant wishes. They wished again and again, until they destroyed both the Teekaz and themselves.
